active_set_policy: Read the current 64 active IDs from config/brand64-active-brands.json. Use the 2026-08-21 daily file as the 08:29 JST base and apply active_daily_overlay_paths in order for later same-day confirmed differences. Inactive legacy rows remain preserved in historical files and are excluded from the current active aggregation.
comparison_policy: Use comparison_daily_path (2026-08-20) for daily comparison. previous_daily_path retains the last pre-transition historical snapshot required to prove BR-00020 any FAM and BR-00048 TAKEO KIKUCHI history preservation. For 2026-08-21, the intraday overlay may confirm later launch/reservation/promotion states, but stale product pages or older crawls must not overwrite fresher live evidence. Do not claim no-change when product-level fields or source freshness are not comparable. Official indexes/search results with non-live crawl timestamps may recover source coverage or create a baseline, but must not be treated as same-day launch, markdown, reservation-state, or stock change without a current product-page confirmation.
offline_policy: Never delete a known product when an official page becomes unavailable. Preserve last confirmed fields and mark SOURCE_OFFLINE with the last confirmed date.
conflict_policy: Do not overwrite a fresher baseline with stale or conflicting index/search values. Record SOURCE_STATE_CONFLICT and require a live product-page recheck.
dedupe_policy: Deduplicate by official product URL and manufacturer product code when available. If neither is available, use brand plus exact product title only as a temporary discovery key until the product page is captured.
brand_id_policy: Never reuse an inactive BR-ID for a new brand. Inactive brands remain INACTIVE_LEGACY_REFERENCE with history preserved.
